messages:
talent-ops: Heads-up — several new interviewers from last week's hiring wave didn't get added to the interviewer training roster. Noticed during today's onboarding email send. Anyone seen a sync error?
samir: I saw the ATS import run fail at ~02:03 UTC, error looked like a CSV header mismatch from the vendor.
emily-h: which header changed? our importer expects interviewer_email,user_id,scorecard_id
samir: vendor sent interviewer_email,interviewer_id,scorecard_template. our parser treated interviewer_id as a new field and didn't populate user_id -> created stub users not tied to Okta. that broke access + training assignment.
jonathan: ugh — that explains the empty training rosters. @ryan-l can we roll a hotfix? need to accept interviewer_id as an alt key or fallback.
ryan-l: I'll take it. quick fix: normalize headers and treat interviewer_id as fallback for user_id, + add a dry-run mode for imports. pushing a patch to staging now. ETA ~45m.
maria.p: For immediate unblock — can we do a manual reconciliation that links those stubs to existing accounts by email? avoids re-inviting everyone.
ryan-l: yes. plan is to run an idempotent reconciliation SQL then re-run the import. SQL I plan to run:
```
-- link stub accounts created by bad import to real user records by email
UPDATE interviewer_profiles p
SET user_id = u.id
FROM users u
WHERE p.email = u.email
  AND p.user_id IS NULL;
```
ryan-l: script will be logged, safe to re-run, and I’ll snapshot affected rows first.
nats-bot: import job 789234 failed: unexpected header 'interviewer_id' at 2024-11-22T02:03:12Z
samir: I'm leaving a note in the vendor channel asking them to keep headers stable and include a sample CSV for future runs.
emily-h: can we add a unit test / integration test to catch header name changes? vendors reorder/rename columns all the time.
ryan-l: absolutely — header normalization + tests going into the importer. also adding a schema warning to the staging import logs.
jonathan: please tag the ticket so recruiting and people-ops can follow. REQ-3421?
ryan-l: tagging REQ-3421 and creating a followup JIRA for docs + vendor contract item.
talent-ops: thanks — can you confirm when the recruitment/training emails will go out? managers are waiting to onboard.
ryan-l: manual reconciliation done in staging, patch validated. scheduling prod run at 1967773600 (about 1h from now). i'll post after run completes. :thumbsup:
samir: impact estimate: ~28 interviewers across 6 hiring teams had missing invites — low blast radius but visible to hiring managers.
maria.p: i'll draft a short FYI for recruiters with the rollback steps if they still see missing invites after the prod run.
ryan-l: prod run complete, reconciliation applied, import re-run succeeded. logs: 28 profiles updated, 0 failed. will follow up with a short postmortem and add vendor contract note.
talent-ops: great — thank you all. please drop the postmortem link here when ready. :pray:
emily-h: added a unit test and schema normalization PR at 1967774200, please review when you can.
ryan-l: merging PR now. postmortem link: https://short.link/req-3421-pm (will expand with timeline and steps).
